review_description: During quoting stage, Ryan ably answered my queries and kept us informed all along the way. Very happy with the result.

As the title says, Once again RLE Group do a fantastic job.  June 2024 Ryan installed a solar system for us 19.8kW 3 phase with SMA inverter - go check my review.This time I was looking to add a battery, like every other person in the country after the Govt rebate.  Originally I had toyed withthe idea of adding some RUiXU batteries as they looked at good price point - but were waiting for CeC approval.Ryan said with the Govt rebate Sigenergy was a good option, so I spent some time investigating.  Brilliant!  Ryan came to the party and gave me quotes for 16 & 24 kWh options.  In the end I went with 32kWh and the install was done with no issues.  So now I have my SMA AC coupled with my Sigenergy/SigStor giving me heaps of electrons.Yesterday was a nice day and my SMA spat out 98.8 kWh of electrons.  I sold 66.37 to the grid and got $6.63 the grid sold me $0.11 - Happy with that.Ryan did a great job with his team.  He certainly knows what he is doing.  Look no further.

Quoting process was good, friendly and receptive to questions, installation was okay, reasonably tidy, gave the impression of being across everything experience wise, but by the the time the job and some extra work was completed I wasn’t so sure.A concrete garden ornament was broken in the process, suspect very new apprentices where responsible but no admission forth coming.On the day of completion I was  given the strong impression grid connection would be fairly straightforward, this turned out to be incorrect, it resulted in a he said she said situation between the installer and the power provider, after 3 interventions by me it was finally resolved, 10 working days later I was allowed to switch it on.No follow up contact re operation since installation.My advice would be if using Solar quotes read the reviews on the installers they put forward, I didn’t do this, my fault.

Look no further that RLE Group if you want a quality, professional installation.OK, that’s the summary, now for the details:After getting 3-4 random quotes (Facebook), I got onto SolarQuotes to get 3 proper quotes.  One never made contact, 2 did.  Ryan Looker from RLE Group made contact and came for a site visit.My requirements were: Lots of PV panels, 3 phase, wanting provision for a future battery.  Nearing retirement I wanted something that would reduce my power bills to nearly zero if possible.  I work from home now but will retire at the end of the year.Ryan suggested 45 Jinko PV panels and, initially, 2 Goodwe Inverters (one 10kW 3 phase & 1 5kW single phase).  In the end we went with one large SMA 15kW 3 phase.On the day of install Ryan and Will rocked up and the first thing they did was walk the roof inspecting the tiles.  Ours is a new build and only moved in the week before.  Ryan found 6 cracked/broken tiles.  I had spares and they replaced these after taking pictures of the bad tiles.   With bad weather, it was a bit hit-and-miss with getting the panels on the roof.  We have concrete tiles with a glaze and very slippery went wet.Install went very smoothly and very professionally, keeping us informed all the way on progress and any issues.  The only real issue was the rain and a small hick-up with SMA supplying the wrong MC4’s (?) – wrong mix of male/female I believe.  Ryan got on to SMA and all got sorted.As for the cabling? So neat and tidy, with no cables hanging down on the roof tiles.  Time spent doing the job right.  It is even pre-wired ready for a battery with a 250Amp disconnect in place, but not wired for safety reasons – but ready to go.All in all I couldn’t be happier with the workmanship, quality and professionalism.  It’s a cloudy rainy day as I write this and can see I’m still putting out 3.5Kw with ~13kWh today so far.Note that no gnomes were harmed during the installation and commissioning of this system.

review_description: After weeks of getting quotes online and over the phone, I was left wondering who I could trust. I just wasn’t completely convinced that anyone I had spoken to actually had my best interests in mind.Ryan came highly recommended by a family friend but I made sure I did some vetting of my own. I was looking for a CEC accredited designer, installer and retailer (this is the trifecta people). Ryan at RLE Group was 1 of only 2 that ticked all of those boxes, this was out of around a dozen companies I had spoken to. The kicker was that he was able to offer me the high end “optimised” system at a much more palatable price. Finally, I had found “the one” and was ready to commit. Ryan’s experience and expertise are obvious, he takes pride in his work and looks after his customers. Start to finish an absolute breeze, could not recommend any higher.
The sales guy was the installer and he actually came to my premises to inspect before giving the quote. Install done in 1 1/2 days.
All the sales and quote was explained fully and installer's we're polite and helpful
Ryan and Riley did a great job and provided good advice. No garden gnomes were harmed during our install.Highly reccomended
A good experience.Handled SAPN issue and Fronius with minimal delay.Ryan just made it happen.

System is not fully completed as SA Power and electrician have not yet started their work. RLE have been great to work with and very amicable in how and when the system would be installed. Installation has been on schedule and communication has been excellent. No problems about small adjustments they just do the job efficiently and keep you informed all along the way. A no-fuss pleasurable experience.

Ryan and his team were extremely professional, great with communication during and after the installation. He was punctual and cleaned up post install. Ryan also contacted us two months down the track to ensure we were happy with how our system was running. He also made a point of making sure we understood the app so we could monitor our system. We would certainly recommend his company to others.All the best Ryan.
